result.instructions: Tools for Typeform, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my forms got the most responses last month?"; "Show me the answers from the last 20 submissions to our onboarding form."; "Create a short feedback form with a rating question and an email field.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Typeform data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run typeform_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run typeform_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run typeform_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. typeform_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: typeform_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces you can access, with their form counts. Use this to find a workspace_id for typeform_list_forms. Typeform API: GET /workspaces.

search.description: Return workspaces whose name contains this text.

tools.name: typeform_get_workspace
tools.title: Get workspace
tools.description: Get one workspace with its name, owning account and form count. Typeform API: GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}.

tools.name: typeform_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List forms in the account (public and private), with id, title, links and last update time. Good first call to find a form_id. Typeform API: GET /forms.

search.description: Return forms whose title contains this text.

is_public.description: Only public (true) or only private (false) forms.

tools.name: typeform_get_form
tools.title: Get form
tools.description: Get the full definition of one form: its fields, choices, logic, settings and theme. Typeform API: GET /forms/{form_id}.

form_id.description: Typeform form id (the short id in the form URL, e.g. abc123).

tools.name: typeform_create_form
tools.title: Create form
tools.description: Create a new form with a title and a list of fields (each with title and type, e.g. short_text, email, multiple_choice). Creates a new form in the account; it does not change existing forms. Typeform API: POST /forms.

fields.description: Form fields. Each object needs title and type, and may include ref, properties and validations.

settings.description: Form settings object, e.g. language, is_public.

tools.name: typeform_list_responses
tools.title: List responses
tools.description: List responses to one form, with answers, hidden fields, metadata and submission time. Use since/until for a date range, or after/before cursors for paging past 1,000 responses. Typeform API: GET /forms/{form_id}/responses.

form_id.description: Typeform form id (the short id in the form URL, e.g. abc123).

since.description: Only responses submitted at or after this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00, or Unix seconds).

until.description: Only responses submitted at or before this time (ISO 8601 UTC or Unix seconds).

after.description: Cursor: responses submitted after this response token (exclusive).

before.description: Cursor: responses submitted before this response token (exclusive).

response_type.description: Comma-separated response types to return, e.g. completed,partial. Default completed.

sort.description: Sort order, e.g. submitted_at,desc (default for completed responses).

query.description: Exact phrase to find in answers, hidden fields or variables.

fields.description: Comma-separated field ids: return only these answers.

tools.name: typeform_search_responses
tools.title: Search responses
tools.description: Search responses to one form with filters: response ids, submission time intervals, tags, answers, metadata and hidden fields, combined with AND. Typeform API: POST /forms/{form_id}/responses/search (read only; no data changes).

form_id.description: Typeform form id (the short id in the form URL, e.g. abc123).

after_response_id.description: Return responses submitted after this response id (exclusive).

before_response_id.description: Return responses submitted before this response id (exclusive).

answered_fields.description: Only responses that answered at least one of these field ids.

fields.description: Restrict the answers section to these field ids.

query.description: Exact phrase to find in answers, hidden fields or variables.

filter_group.description: Filters combined with AND. Each filter has field, operator (equals, any_of, interval, contains) and value.

tools.name: typeform_list_themes
tools.title: List themes
tools.description: List the themes in the account (colors, fonts, background). Typeform API: GET /themes.

tools.name: typeform_get_theme
tools.title: Get theme
tools.description: Get one theme with its colors, fonts and background settings. Typeform API: GET /themes/{theme_id}.

tools.name: typeform_list_images
tools.title: List images
tools.description: List the images uploaded to the account (id, file name, size and links). Typeform API: GET /images.

tools.name: typeform_get_image
tools.title: Get image
tools.description: Get one uploaded image's metadata and links. Typeform API: GET /images/{image_id}.

tools.name: typeform_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks set up for one form (tag, URL, enabled state, event types). Typeform API: GET /forms/{form_id}/webhooks.

form_id.description: Typeform form id (the short id in the form URL, e.g. abc123).

tools.name: typeform_get_webhook
tools.title: Get webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook of a form by its tag. Typeform API: GET /forms/{form_id}/webhooks/{tag}.

form_id.description: Typeform form id (the short id in the form URL, e.g. abc123).

tag.description: Webhook tag, e.g. my-crm. Use typeform_list_webhooks to find it.

tools.name: typeform_set_webhook
tools.title: Create or update webhook
tools.description: Create or replace the webhook with this tag on one form. Typeform then sends form response events to the URL. Calling it again with the same tag replaces the webhook. Typeform API: PUT /forms/{form_id}/webhooks/{tag}.

form_id.description: Typeform form id (the short id in the form URL, e.g. abc123).

tag.description: Webhook tag (a name you choose, e.g. my-crm).

url.description: HTTPS URL that receives the webhook payloads.

enabled.description: Send responses to the URL right away (default true).

event_types.description: Event types to send. form_response = completed responses.

verify_ssl.description: Verify the receiving server's SSL certificate.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Typeform
prompts.description: What you can do with Typeform here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_forms_and_read_their_responses
prompts.title: Find forms and read their responses
prompts.description: List the workspaces, then the forms in the account. Read the responses of one form, with answers and submission times.

prompts.name: search_responses_by_answer_or_time
prompts.title: Search responses by answer or time
prompts.description: Search the responses of a form with filters on submission time, tags, answers, metadata and hidden fields.

prompts.name: read_the_fields_and_logic_of_a_form
prompts.title: Read the fields and logic of a form
prompts.description: Get the full definition of one form: its fields, choices, logic and settings. List the themes to see the colors and fonts.

prompts.name: create_a_new_form
prompts.title: Create a new form
prompts.description: Create a form with a title and fields, such as a rating or an email field. Existing forms do not change.

prompts.name: send_responses_to_a_url_with_a_webhook
prompts.title: Send responses to a URL with a webhook
prompts.description: Create or replace the webhook with a tag on one form. Typeform then sends form response events to the URL. List the webhooks of a form to check them.

prompts.name: review_uploaded_images
prompts.title: Review uploaded images
prompts.description: List the images uploaded to the account with their links. Get the metadata and links of one image.
